tool.title: Connect your flight controller
tool.intro: Plug the board into this computer with a USB data cable, press Connect and pick its port (usually “STM32 Virtual ComPort”). Keep the propeller off while you set things up.
tool.support.ok: Your browser can talk to the board over USB.
tool.support.webusb: This browser has no Web Serial, so the tool uses WebUSB instead (Android: Chrome with a USB-OTG adapter).
tool.support.none: This browser can’t open USB serial ports. Use Chrome, Edge or Opera on Windows, macOS or Linux, or Chrome on Android with a USB-OTG adapter. iPhone and iPad can’t do it: their browsers have no Web Serial or WebUSB.
tool.support.insecure: Open this page over https:// — browsers allow USB access only on secure pages.
tool.mock: Demo mode: a simulated board, nothing real is connected.
tool.status.reconnecting: Board disconnected. Plug it back in — the page reconnects by itself.
tool.verdict.other: This is Betaflight, but not a Shramko Motor Autostart build. Read the settings to check for the module — or install the firmware.
tool.verdict.notbf: This board runs {variant}, not Betaflight. Install the Shramko Motor Autostart firmware first.
tool.verdict.stock: The autostart module is not on this board. Install the Shramko Motor Autostart firmware.
tool.level.old: This board has firmware 1.0: gusts, run time, throttle limit and the battery cut-off need firmware 1.1.
tool.live.title: Live
tool.live.stopped: Program stopped — press Restart program to run it again
tool.live.noEsc: No answer from an ESC on any output
tool.live.noTelemetry: Not available: bidirectional DShot (dshot_bidir) is off on this board
tool.live.debugOff: Live status needs debug_mode = AUTOSTART on the board.
tool.live.debugStaged: Will be turned on when you press Save to board.
tool.stop.sent: Stop sent: every output at 1000 µs. The program stays stopped until you restart it.
tool.stop.already: The motor is already stopped while the settings are open.
tool.stop.queued: The board is restarting — the stop is sent the moment it is back.
tool.restart.title: Restart the motor program?
tool.restart.body: The board restarts and the program runs from the beginning: {delay} s countdown, then the motor ramps up to {thr} %.
tool.restart.bodyUnknown: The board restarts and the program runs from the beginning with the settings saved on it.
tool.restart.check: The propeller is off, or nothing and nobody is near it.
tool.restart.done: Board restarted. The program is running from the start.
tool.settings.title: Settings
tool.read.warn: Reading settings stops the motor until the board restarts.
tool.preset.gusts.help: 20 % base with random gusts of 50–90 %, 0.2–0.6 s long, every 1.5–6 s.
tool.gusts.off: Pick the Gusts pattern (or the Gusts preset) to use these.
tool.f.autostart_mode.label: Start
tool.f.autostart_delay.label: Delay before the ramp
tool.f.autostart_delay.help: Counted from the moment the battery is plugged in (or the click).
tool.f.autostart_ramp.label: Ramp time
tool.f.autostart_ramp.help: Smooth rise from zero to the target throttle.
tool.f.autostart_throttle.label: Throttle
tool.f.autostart_throttle.help: Steady level; with gusts, the level between them.
tool.f.autostart_throttle_limit.label: Throttle limit
tool.f.autostart_throttle_limit.help: Hard cap for everything the program sends, gusts included.
tool.f.autostart_run_time.label: Run time
tool.f.autostart_run_time.help: How long to run after the ramp.
tool.zero.autostart_run_time: Until the battery cut-off or power off
tool.f.autostart_pattern.label: Pattern
tool.f.autostart_pattern.help: Gusts add random sharp bursts on top of the steady level.
tool.f.autostart_gust_min.label: Weakest gust
tool.f.autostart_gust_max.label: Strongest gust
tool.f.autostart_gust_max.help: Each gust picks a random peak between the weakest and the strongest.
tool.f.autostart_gust_len_min.label: Shortest gust
tool.f.autostart_gust_len_max.label: Longest gust
tool.f.autostart_gust_pause_min.label: Shortest pause
tool.f.autostart_gust_pause_min.help: Shortest time at the steady level between gusts.
tool.f.autostart_gust_pause_max.label: Longest pause
tool.f.autostart_gust_pause_max.help: Longest time at the steady level between gusts.
tool.f.autostart_cells.label: Battery cells
tool.f.autostart_cells.help: Cell count of the pack (6 for a 6S battery).
tool.zero.autostart_cells: Detect automatically (unreliable with a half-empty pack)
tool.f.autostart_cell_cutoff.label: Cut-off voltage per cell
tool.f.autostart_cell_cutoff.help: Stops the motor when the battery stays below this, to protect the pack.
tool.f.autostart_motors.label: Outputs driven
tool.f.autostart_motors.help: Motor outputs that get the throttle. 1–4 are the four signal wires of the cable.
tool.f.autostart_usb_inhibit.label: With a computer connected
tool.f.autostart_usb_inhibit.help: Choose whether the motor may spin while USB is plugged in.
tool.f.autostart_vbat_min.label: Battery detection
tool.f.autostart_vbat_min.help: A battery counts as plugged in from this voltage; the countdown starts then.
tool.f.autostart_cutoff_time.label: Cut-off delay
tool.f.autostart_cutoff_time.help: The voltage must stay low this long before the stop (ignores sag during gusts).
tool.f.autostart_box.label: RC switch
tool.f.autostart_box.help: With a receiver: the AUX mode (USER1–4) that runs the program.
tool.f.vbat_scale.label: Voltage scale (vbat_scale)
tool.f.vbat_scale.help: Board calibration. The helper in Battery sets it from a multimeter reading.
tool.cal.title: Calibrate the voltage
tool.cal.noReading: Plug in the battery to calibrate: the board shows no voltage.
tool.cal.result: New scale {new} (was {old}). Press Save to board to keep it.
tool.cal.clamped: Limited to the allowed 10–255: check the reading and the wiring.
tool.cal.badInput: Type the voltage your multimeter shows, for example 24.3.
tool.save.hint: Saving restarts the board. Keep the propeller off while you change settings.
tool.defaults.note: Defaults are in the form (the voltage calibration is kept). Press Save to board to apply them.
tool.note.swapped: Swapped so the smaller value comes first.
tool.note.mask: At least one output must stay on.
tool.step.reconnect: Waiting for the board to come back…
tool.step.verify: Reading back to check every value…
tool.saved.after: The program is stopped because the settings were read. Press Restart program when you are ready.
tool.err.no-api: This browser can’t open USB serial ports. Use Chrome, Edge or Opera on a computer, or Chrome on Android with a USB-OTG adapter.
tool.err.insecure: Open this page over https:// — browsers allow USB access only on secure pages.
tool.err.cancelled: No port selected. Press Connect again and pick the board’s port.
tool.err.permission: The browser or the system refused access to the port. Allow USB access and try again.
tool.err.busy: The port is busy. Close Betaflight Configurator (and any other program using the board), then press Connect again.
tool.err.not-open: The board is not connected. Press Connect.
tool.err.lost: The board disconnected. Plug it back in; the page reconnects by itself.
tool.err.timeout: The board stopped answering. Unplug it, plug it back in and press Connect.
tool.err.reconnect-timeout: The board did not come back after restarting. Unplug the USB cable and plug it back in — the page keeps waiting and reconnects by itself.
tool.err.no-answer: This port doesn’t answer like a Betaflight flight controller. Pick the board’s port (often “STM32 Virtual ComPort”), or close Betaflight Configurator.
tool.err.msp-error: The board refused a request. Check that it runs Betaflight 2025.12.
tool.err.cli: The board’s command line did not answer. Unplug and replug the board, then try again.
tool.err.cli-invalid-value: The board refused {name} = {value}. Nothing was saved.
tool.err.cli-invalid-name: This firmware has no setting {name}. Nothing was saved — update the firmware.
tool.err.verify: Saved, but the board kept different values: {list}. Try again; if it repeats, tell us with the Feedback button.
tool.err.not-ours: The autostart module is not on this board.
tool.err.busy-op: Wait for the current step to finish.
tool.err.internal: Something went wrong on our side ({msg}). Please tell us with the Feedback button.
